messages:
jamal: FinTrust follow-up: they want Q12 filled out in the SIG about tenant isolation + an evidence bundle. Request: short plain-English narrative, an architecture diagram, example network/k8s policy, and a reproducible smoke-test log. Can we deliver by EOD tomorrow?

maria: I can write the narrative draft. Need the diagram + a sanitized snippet of our namespace isolation policy. @alex can you confirm encryption key handling details?

alex: Will grab diagrams and produce a redacted draw.io export. Note: we must not include internal IPs, hostnames, or customer IDs in artifacts. I'll attach a trimmed NetworkPolicy YAML and an S3 prefix example.

sarah: From security side: include a short threat-model list, bullet controls mapped to each flow segment, smoke-test steps with timestamps/results, and a line on breach containment behavior (circuit-breaker/fail-closed).

nina: I can assemble the ZIP for upload. Proposed artifact names: redwood-dataflow-tenant-v1.png, ns-isolation-policy.yaml, kms-keying-summary.pdf, tenant-smoketest-2026-03-18.log.zip. Where should I put them (GDrive or S3)?

jamal: Also quick language question: can we say 'logical multitenancy with tenant-scoped controls' or do we need to explicitly say 'data at rest is never co-mingled'?

alex: Be explicit for the SIG. Suggested phrasing: 'Tenant data is segregated in separate storage prefixes; hosted customers use per-tenant KMS keys, Dedicated/Private customers may provide customer-managed keys.' I'll add sample aliases and a minimal terraform snippet (sanitized).

maria: Draft narrative v0: 'Redwood enforces tenant isolation via separate storage prefixes, tenant-scoped encryption keys, namespace-level network segmentation, and RBAC enforced by the control plane. Authentication can be delegated to customer IdP or Redwood-managed tokens.' Feedback welcome.

sarah: Add acceptance criteria for the smoke test (no cross-tenant read, write latency within SLA, audit events generated, and remediation steps if noisy tenant observed). Also mention KMS rotation cadence and key access audit log retention.

jamal: Legal asked if FinTrust wants a notarized attestation later; flagging for legal. For now, SIG artifacts only.

sig-bot: Artifact checklist update: redwood-dataflow-tenant-v1.png (pending), ns-isolation-policy.yaml (pending), tenant-smoketest-2026-03-18.log.zip (pending).

nina: Uploaded interim artifacts to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED. Logs are redacted (no hostnames).

alex: Inline examples for the SIG, sanitized:
```bash
# example storage prefix
s3://redwood-hosted/customer-REDACTED/data/
# kms key alias
alias/redwood/customer-REDACTED
```
and a trimmed NetworkPolicy example:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: isolate-tenant-namespace
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tenant: "REDACTED"
```

maria: Updated narrative to call out per-tenant KMS aliasing and noisy-tenant remediation steps. PTAL @sarah @alex.

sarah: LGTM with one edit: change 'customer-managed for Dedicated' -> 'customer-managed for Dedicated and Private deployments'.

jamal: Owners: @nina create final SIG ZIP, @maria finalize narrative, @alex attach redacted config snippets, @sarah final sign-off. Target: tomorrow 18:00 PST. Any blockers?

alex: No blockers. I'll include a tiny terraform example with placeholders and confirm our KMS rotation doc name.

nina: Final ZIP uploaded to S3: https://s3.redwood.example/sig-packages/fintrust-tenant-isolation-1769912345.zip (share link pending). All sensitive fields removed.

jamal: :thumbsup: Once @sarah signs off I'll submit to FinTrust's portal. Thanks everyone."
